newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley earns $509 million in 2nd quarter.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley earns $509 million in 2nd quarter.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Dean Witter Discover & Co., reporting results for the first time since the merger of the two brokerage companies, said Wednesday it earned $509 million in its second quarter, down from $551 million a year earlier.

The results included $63 million in one-time costs related to the merger. Excluding those and other acquisition-related charges, Morgan earned $590 million, or 97 cents a share, up from 92 cents a share earlier.
Sales increased to $3.5 billion from $3.1 billion.

"We're very pleased with the strong revenues in our three primary businesses -- securities, asset management and credit services," Phil J. Purcell, chairman, and John J. Mack, president, said in a joint statement.
The securities business earned $312 million, down 13 percent from a record quarter a year earlier, the company said.
Investment banking revenues totalled $581 million, down slightly from a year earlier, reflecting lower levels of market activity, Morgan said.
Institutional securities had a strong second quarter, the company said, with record revenue in foreign exchange and near-record revenue in equities.
The merger of Morgan Stanley and Dean Witter Discover & Co. was completed May 31.
In early trading, Morgan's stock was down 50 cents at $45.75 a share on the New York Stock Exchange.
